prompt: You say you want to get better at guitar, but your practice feels aimless. Which next step is most specific and useful?

options.text: Practise random songs for several hours at the weekend
Practise switching between two chords you use often, for ten minutes after dinner on weekdays, aiming for clean changes
Buy a better guitar before practising any more
Watch guitar videos without picking up the instrument

explanation: A specific target (two chords), a small set time, and a clear standard (clean changes) turn a vague wish into practice you can start, repeat and measure.
